about: Per-file mutation floors (percent) for the integration pass (stryker.integration.conf.mjs), checked by scripts/ci/mutation-file-floor.mjs --floors mutation-floors.integration.json.
The same ratchet as mutation-floors.json: raise a floor when the integration specs kill its survivors, never lower it.

Set 2026-11-24 at the scores of two local runs, which were identical file by file (373 mutants, 0 errors at concurrency 1, 26 and 27 minutes), rounded down. These are low because no mutation run had ever judged the handlers; each survivor in the report is a route behaviour the Miniflare specs do not check.
